test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 09
subject: general
question: The Government of India has notified Coking Coal as a Critical and Strategic Mineral under which Act, in line with the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat 2047?

options.text: Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Government of India has notified Coking Coal as a Critical and Strategic Mineral under the MMDR Act, 1957.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Coking coal has been included as a Critical and Strategic Mineral.
 
• The notification is under the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957.
 
• The move aligns with the vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat 2047.
 
• The decision is based on recommendations of the High-Level Committee on Viksit Bharat Goals and inputs from NITI Aayog.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• MMDR Act, 1957__

 __
 
• Regulates the mining sector in India.
 
• Provides the legal framework for exploration and extraction of minerals.
 
• Section 11C empowers the Centre to designate critical and strategic minerals.
 
 
 
• Significance of Coking Coal__
 
 
• Essential raw material for the steel industry.
 
• India meets about 95% of its coking coal requirement through imports.
 
• Domestic development aims to reduce import dependence and foreign exchange outgo.
